what_this_is: Whether the same clusters mean the same thing in 2023 and in 2024, on two disjoint windows rather than cumulative prefixes.
only_spending_moves: Every land, soil, elevation, area and socio column in the panel is a snapshot, so movement here is spending movement plus Hansen's two loss-years. It cannot be attributed to the land changing.

eligibility.note: The shipped rule is 12 of 24 months; the proportional analogue inside one year is 6 of 12.

why_the_existing_monthly_artifact_cannot: artifacts/dynamics/monthly_clusters.json reports ARI against the published partition rising to 1.0 at 2024-12. Cumulative months through December are the shipped window, so that value is identity, not stabilization.
